item.title: ‘India has achieved fastest 5G rollout’
item.description: Bhubaneswar: Telecom Regulatory Authority of India (TRAI) Chairman Anil Kumar Lahoti Thursday said that India has achieved the fastest rollout of 5G services globally, supported by over 1.23 billion telecom subscribers and nearly 99 per cent 4G coverage. item.description: Cuttack: The Odisha Police has put in place elaborate security arrangements for the India–South Africa T20 International cricket match scheduled at Barabati Stadium in Cuttack December 9. item.title: Youth climbs atop tower, makes girlfriend’s parents let them talk
item.description: Keonjhar/Patana: A 29-year-old man in Keonjhar district scaled a high-voltage power transmission tower Thursday in a dramatic attempt to speak with his girlfriend. The incident brought to onlookers’ mind scenes from the 1975 Bollywood blockbluster Sholay. item.title: Basta Assembly segment leads Odisha yet again
item.description: Balasore: Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s 128th edition of ‘Mann Ki Baat’ was broadcast across polling booths nationwide November 30, with the Basta Assembly constituency once again topping participation in Odisha. item.description: Mumbai: RBI Governor Sanjay Malhotra announced Friday that the monetary policy committee (MPC) meeting had unanimously decided to reduce the repo rate by 25 basis points to 5.25 per cent from 5.5 per cent earlier to spur growth in the economy. item.title: RBI hikes India’s GDP growth forecast to 7.3%
item.description: Mumbai: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) Friday raised its GDP growth forecast of the Indian economy to a robust 7.3 per cent for 2025-26 from 6.8 per cent earlier, on the back of an improved outlook driven by strong agricultural prospects, GST rate cuts continuing to play out, low inflation and strong balance sheets […]

item.description: New Delhi: IndiGo Friday cancelled all its departing domestic flights from the Delhi airport till midnight as the airline continues to grapple with significant operational disruptions.
